description_en: Queries the descriptions of time-series monitoring items that are open to cloud monitoring
description_zh: 查询云监控开放的时序类监控项的监控项描述
name: QueryMetricMeta

parameters.help_en: The Project to which the metric belongs, matched by equality
parameters.help_zh: 指标所属的Project，按等于匹配
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
Filter by labels, format `[{"name":"label name","value":"label value"},{"name":"label name","value":"label value"}]`.
Existing label name explanations: 

- MetricCategory: Description of the metric category  
- alertEnable: Whether an alert is needed  
- alertUnit: Suggested alert unit 
- unitFactor: Unit conversion factor  
- minAlertPeriod: Minimum alert period  
- productCategory: Product type category
parameters.help_zh:
根据标签过滤，格式`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"},{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}] `。
已有的标签name说明： 

- MetricCategory：监控项分类的描述  
- alertEnable：是否需要报警  
- alertUnit：建议的报警单位 
- unitFactor：单位转换系数  
- minAlertPeriod：最小报警周期  
- productCategory：产品类型分类
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The metric name, matched by equality
parameters.name: metric

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of items per page, default is 30
parameters.name: page_size
